Fiddlers Green has fair prospects but Ocean Heights looks a bigger threat arriving in good form at a course that suits well (twice a winner)

A wide draw is not ideal but he can be ridden patiently again and unleash a potent turn of foot in the straight wehn in the clear. He should go very close again but CROWN IMPERIAL is fancied to exploit the weight received from the only previous winner in the field (6lb penalty) having made a solid start to his carrer when fifth of 10 at Newbury in May. He went off favourite that day and is obviously held in some regard by connections. Newcomer Ethelwulf needs respecting and strong market support would make him interesting but next on the list is Sea Of Kings, another to have attracted strong market support last time, ahead of Ivatt and The Bellhop

Prior to that mishap he was beaten just a neck over course and distance and if fit to fire he can go very close again

selections.comment: ECHO OF GLORY made a striking handicap debut when scoring at Bath over 1m to open his account in mid-June and was under a length away bidding to land the double last time on soft ground raised to class 5 company. The Polytrack surface holds no real fears (not beaten far when a fair 7th of 11 on second start) and he  can resume winning ways eased back to this level. I Follow Rivers is still progressing and is next on the list. Richard Spencer's gelding arrives in fine form having won twice already this year, including here over 7f in early May, and was denied by a neck last time at Wolverhampton over the extended mile. There should still be a bit more to come and he's entitled to go close again. Better runs can be anticiapted from Rory's Gold and Papa Oscar and both could challenge for honours if giving best but Harryella and Le Pelerin are more solid alternatives. Despite a slight concern that Polytrack suits (below par both runs on it) the latter seems to be on a greater upward trajectory and is just preferred

selections.comment: A race where most of the field have big questions to answer. It's hard to be confident about any delivering their best so Adace is tempting, just 1lb higher than when winning here over 7f in October five starts back. Her form dipped shortly after and her comeback run in late May over course and distance was hardly inspiring, however, she lost all chace at the start then and if breaking on terms a much better effort can be reasonably expected. She's a course and distance winner and is entitled to go close if giving best but ROMANOVICH looks more solid and just gets the nod. A winner on penultimate start and not beaten too far off a rise upped to class 5 company last time he arrives in the best shape of the field. It's possible 7f suits best but he stays a mile (winner twice over it) and is entitled to go close. Drumstick and Wadacre Grace both require a big step forward on recent efforts but there are reasons to suggest both are capable of deleivering better and if closer to their best are greatly feared. The former is must preferred given he's more likely to spring back to form now returned to the AW after a coulple of modest efforts on turf since he was placed (beaten under two lengths) over CD in mid-April

selections.comment: This looks the tougher division with a number in the field arriving in decent nick, none more so than Just Typical and Bold Suitor, both last time out winners and in with a great shout again. Just Typical won a class 6 handicap last time but appears to be still progressing of late and is entitled to go close but may find the 5lb rise a bit too much and find a couple too strong. Bold Suitor could be one. A course and distance winner whose been in rude-health in 2025 and took a significant step forward last time to win by five lengths when heavily supported. He rated much higher early in his career and could possibly cope with the 9lb rise for that but top-weight SERENITY DREAM takes a marked drop in grade and is preferred. He's hit form in his last three runs and his sole win came here over seven furlongs with the only other run at the track resulting in a head defeat. He can land a second career win off a career low mark

selections.comment: An open race with a host of progressive stayers. The selection is having his first flat run for this yard but was an easy winner over hurdles last time and is potentially very well treated on his French form in this sphere. With the longer trip likely to suit he can get the better of Londonofficecallin who has been improving in both spheres for some time and remains unexposed over staying distances on the flat.
